algorithm.targetFormula: cap-free percentile seed plus bounded measured-rate refinement
algorithm.candidateSelection: lowest absolute rate error per independent level, then one final combined deterministic confirmation pass
algorithm.focusedOverrides: tracked overrides come from bounded per-level native-policy sweeps and are applied before the final combined confirmation
algorithm.staleRatioUsage: comparison only; 87/100 supplied oldTarget values do not match the source catalog
algorithm.policyAggregation: best deterministic policy per layout (one outcome per layout)
algorithm.solvabilityStatement: A clear from a native competent policy is constructive route evidence. Missing policy routes are not proof of impossibility; the absent exhaustive solver artifact is still required for that.
